facts.en: Completed a BSc in Business Analytics at Fictional Institute D050 in 2020.
facts.zh: 2020 年在虚构院校 D050 完成商业分析理学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a campaign operations assistant at Fictional B2B Publisher D050 from 2021-04 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-04 至 2026-08 在虚构 B2B 出版商 D050 担任营销活动运营助理。

facts.en: Prepared segmented webinar invitation lists using approved CRM fields and suppression rules.
facts.zh: 使用获批 CRM 字段及抑制规则准备分组网络研讨会邀请名单。

facts.en: Checked duplicate contacts, consent flags and test links before requesting a campaign manager’s send approval.
facts.zh: 在请求营销活动经理批准发送前，检查重复联系人、同意标记及测试链接。

facts.en: With the CRM administrator, standardized pre-send checks for 10 webinar campaigns in 2025-Q3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-Q3 与 CRM 管理员合作，为 10 场网络研讨会营销活动标准化发送前检查。

facts.en: In those 10 campaigns, 27 duplicate list entries were removed before send; this is a list-quality count, not an incremental sales result.
facts.zh: 在这 10 场营销活动中，发送前删除 27 条重复名单记录；这是名单质量计数，而非新增销售成果。

facts.en: Built weekly funnel tables from exported campaign and CRM data, with definitions approved by the analyst.
facts.zh: 根据导出的营销活动及 CRM 数据建立每周漏斗表，定义经分析师批准。

facts.en: Used spreadsheet joins and pivots to reconcile registration totals; did not administer CRM permissions or integrations.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格连接及数据透视表核对报名总数；未管理 CRM 权限或集成。

facts.en: Coordinated execution of a 2026-01 subject-line test with 2 approved variants; the analyst selected the audience split and interpreted results.
facts.zh: 在 2026-01 协调执行包含 2 个获批版本的邮件主题测试；分析师选择受众分组并解读结果。

facts.en: Drafted a lead-scoring model in 2026-04 using fictional examples; it was not deployed to the live CRM.
facts.zh: 2026-04 使用虚构示例起草潜客评分模型；未部署至真实业务 CRM。

facts.en: Supported 6 concurrent campaigns at the 2025-11 peak; the routine 2026-08 workload was 3.
facts.zh: 在 2025-11 高峰期支持 6 场并行营销活动；2026-08 常规工作量为 3 场。

facts.en: Volunteered on evenings for Fictional Makers Newsletter V050 from 2023-09 to 2024-04 while employed, editing event listings.
facts.zh: 2023-09 至 2024-04 任职期间，晚间为虚构创客通讯 V050 志愿编辑活动列表。

facts.en: Designed a personal recipe-card collection as a hobby; it was not commissioned marketing collateral.
facts.zh: 出于爱好设计个人食谱卡片集；并非受委托制作的营销材料。

facts.en: Documented naming conventions and campaign handovers for sales-development colleagues.
facts.zh: 为销售开发同事记录命名规则及营销活动交接信息。

facts.en: Did not own paid-media budgets, revenue forecasts or the final legal interpretation of consent requirements.
facts.zh: 未负责付费媒体预算、收入预测或同意要求的最终法律解释。

facts.en: A draft achievements sheet claims 300 qualified leads, whereas the retained export contains 300 registrations with no qualification field.
facts.zh: 一份成果草稿声称获得 300 个合格潜客，而留存导出数据为 300 个报名记录，没有资格评定字段。

facts.en: A profile note lists an email-platform administrator certificate, but the attached badge title says introductory campaign training.
facts.zh: 一份简介备注列出邮件平台管理员证书，但所附徽章名称为入门营销活动培训。

facts.en: Used a checklist to escalate conflicting consent flags to the privacy contact rather than deciding the legal basis independently.
facts.zh: 使用清单将冲突的同意标记上报隐私联系人，而非独立决定法律依据。
